title: KLIA2 Airport Taxi: How to Find the Taxi Counter
metaDescription: The ttklia.com taxi counters at KLIA2 are on Level 2, by Door 2 and Door 3. Follow the walk from the arrival hall, with ttklia's video.

contentBlocks.content: There are two ttklia.com taxi counters at KLIA2, both on Level 2, the same floor as the arrival hall. Leave arrivals by Door B and walk straight through the Gateway@klia2 shops. Just past FamilyMart, the first counter is on your right by Door 2. The second is a red kiosk outside Door 3, next to the taxi queue. You do not need to change floors.
Key Takeaways
Which floor are the taxi counters on? Level 2, the arrivals floor. No escalators or lifts.
Which counter is closer? Door 2. It is on your right just after FamilyMart.
Where do the taxis leave from? The taxi queue and waiting area outside Door 3.
Can I skip the counter? Yes. Book a fixed price taxi on ttklia.com before you fly and your driver meets you in the arrival hall with a name board.
Watch the walk first
ttklia filmed the route from the KLIA2 arrival hall to both taxi counters. It runs under a minute. Watch it before you land so you know what to look for.
Video: ttklia on TikTok
Step by step: arrival hall to the Door 2 counter

1. Leave the arrival hall by Door B. After baggage and customs you come out on Level 2. Look for the pillar marked with a large B.
  2. Walk straight under the overhead signs for Bus and Taxi (Bas dan Teksi).
  3. Pass the green AirAsia MOVE billboard and keep going into the Gateway@klia2 mall.
  4. Go straight past Homeworld and ZUS Coffee.
  5. Find the direction board that says "You Are Now At Level 2". FamilyMart is on your left.
  6. Look right. The ttklia.com taxi counter, with a yellow TAXI sign on the desk, is beside Door 2 (Pintu 2).
To the Door 3 counter and the taxi queue

1. At FamilyMart, turn left and go straight along the corridor.
  2. Pass the CIMB Bank currency exchange.
  3. Door 3 (Pintu 3) is on your right. Go out through it.
  4. The ttklia.com taxi counter is on your left, a red kiosk with a taxi on its side. It lists three car types: Budget, Premier and Family.
  5. The taxi queue and waiting area are right there outside Door 3. Taxis pull up at the kerb.
If you get turned around, look for the door numbers. They are printed above every exit on Level 2 as Pintu (Door) and Keluar (Exit).
Book before you land

Walking up to the counter works, but you can also sort the ride before you fly. ttklia.com sells fixed price taxis from KLIA2 by sedan, MPV or van, with no meter and no surge pricing. For central Kuala Lumpur, including KL Sentral, pick the KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang and Bangsar zone. Your driver tracks your flight and waits in the KLIA2 arrival hall with a name board, so you do not need the counter at all.

contentBlocks.content: Other ways out of KLIA2

• Grab. Pickup is in the Transportation Hub on the LG floor, not at the taxi queue. Follow the e-hailing signs.
  • Bus. The bus counter is one floor down, in the Transportation Hub on Level 1. Our KLIA2 bus station guide has the walk and a video.
  • Train. KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit tickets are sold on Level 2 of Gateway@klia2, with the platforms on Level 1.
Frequently Asked Questions
Where is the taxi counter at KLIA2?
There are two ttklia.com taxi counters on Level 2. One is inside by Door 2, on your right just after FamilyMart. The other is a red kiosk just outside Door 3, next to the taxi queue.
Do I need to go downstairs for a taxi at KLIA2?
No. The taxi counters and the taxi queue are all on Level 2, the floor you arrive on. Only Grab and the buses are downstairs.
Where do I wait for my taxi at KLIA2?
In the taxi queue and waiting area outside Door 3 on Level 2. If you booked online, your driver meets you in the arrival hall instead.
Is Grab pickup at the same place as taxis?
No. Grab picks up in the Transportation Hub on the LG floor. Taxis leave from outside Door 3 on Level 2.
Conclusion

The KLIA2 taxi counters are on the arrivals floor: Door B, straight through Gateway@klia2, and the first counter is on your right by Door 2 after FamilyMart. The second is outside Door 3, by the taxi queue. Watch ttklia's video once, or book your taxi on ttklia.com before you fly and meet your driver in the arrival hall.
